claims.snippet: Dissolve ingredients (except magnesium chloride, carbonate, glucose and reducing agents) and sparge medium with 80% N2 and 20% CO2 gas mixture for 30 -45 min to make it anoxic. Dispense medium under same gas atmosphere into anoxic Hungate-type tubes or serum vials and autoclave. Add magnesium chloride, glucose, cysteine and sulfide from sterile anoxic stock solutions prepared under 100% N2 gas and carbonate from a sterile anoxic stock solution prepared under 80% N2 and 20% CO2 gas mixture. The glucose solution should be sterilized by filtration. Adjust pH of complete medium to 6.8 - 7.0, if necessary.
claims.explanation: Manual source review withheld support: Magnesium chloride, glucose, cysteine, sulfide and carbonate come from separate sterile anoxic stocks with different gas/preparation requirements. The flat record does not represent these stages.

Add maltose and DTT from sterile anoxic stock solutions prepared under 100% N2 gas and sterilized by filtration and carbonate from a sterile stock solution prepared under 80% N2 and 20% CO2 gas atmosphere. Check pH of complete medium and adjust to 7.4, if necessary.
claims.explanation: Manual source review withheld support: Carbonate, maltose and DTT use separately sterilized stocks and gas conditions, omitted locally. Resolve preparation and exact source-version context, including the changed source name, before endorsing matching flat amounts.

Dispense medium under 100% N2 gas atmosphere into anoxic Hungate-type tubes or serum vials and autoclave. Add thiosulfate and glucose from anoxic stock solutions prepared under 100% N2 gas and sterilized by filtration. Adjust pH of complete medium to 7.0, if necessary.
claims.explanation: Manual source review withheld support: Thiosulfate and glucose are separate sterile anoxic stocks added after autoclaving, whereas cysteine is added before it. Those stock and preparation boundaries are absent locally; source-name/version equivalence also needs review.

withholdings.snippet: After autoclaving, aseptically add 100 ml of a 10% Na2CO3 solution to the medium. Check final pH to be about 10.0.
withholdings.reason: The basal recipe uses 900 ml water and receives 100 ml of a 10% carbonate stock after autoclaving. The percent basis and stock boundary are absent locally; do not endorse the flattened carbonate or assume a measured final litre. Original PDF corroborates these separate inputs.

withholdings.snippet: Dissolve ingredients (except urea and thioglycolate), boil medium for 1 min, then cool to room temperature under 80% N2 and 20% CO2 gas mixture. Add thioglycolate, dispense medium under same gas atmosphere into anoxic Hungate-type tubes or serum vials and autoclave. After autoclaving add urea from a 10% (w/v) stock solution sterilized by filtration and stored under 100% N2 gas. Adjust pH of complete medium to 7.4.
withholdings.reason: Urea is added from a filter-sterilized anoxic 10% w/v stock, and resazurin is a separate 0.1% w/v stock. The local flat formulation omits stock and basal-versus-completed preparation stages.

withholdings.snippet: Yeast extract and sodium pyruvate are added from sterile (autoclaved) stock solutions to the respective concentrations.
withholdings.reason: Yeast extract and pyruvate are separate sterile stock additions; the table also specifies a 1 M Tris stock. Reconstruct the missing stock strengths, addition and preparation boundaries before endorsing the flat formulation.

withholdings.snippet: Dissolve ingredients (except magnesium chloride, carbonate, glucose and reducing agents) and sparge medium with 80% N2 and 20% CO2 gas mixture for 30 -45 min to make it anoxic. Dispense medium under same gas atmosphere into anoxic Hungate-type tubes or serum vials and autoclave. Add magnesium chloride, glucose, cysteine and sulfide from sterile anoxic stock solutions prepared under 100% N2 gas and carbonate from a sterile anoxic stock solution prepared under 80% N2 and 20% CO2 gas mixture. The glucose solution should be sterilized by filtration. Adjust pH of complete medium to 6.8 - 7.0, if necessary.
withholdings.reason: Magnesium chloride, glucose, cysteine, sulfide and carbonate come from separate sterile anoxic stocks with different gas/preparation requirements. The flat record does not represent these stages.
